title: Web Technology Overview
summary:
Web Technology Overview

Web technology encompasses a broad range of tools and techniques essential for internet communication, including web browsers, web pages, web servers, and the process of web development. Web browsers play a crucial role by rendering content from web pages, allowing users to interact with online information seamlessly. Web servers manage incoming requests and serve web pages via HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol), ensuring efficient data delivery.

Web development is divided into two main components: frontend and backend. Frontend development focuses on creating user-interactable elements using languages such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. HTML serves as the backbone for designing the structure of web pages, while CSS simplifies styling by allowing independent control over visual aspects without altering the content's underlying code. JavaScript enhances website interactivity and functionality, enabling dynamic behaviors that improve user experience.

For backend development, several server-side scripting languages are utilized to handle data processing and management. PHP is a widely-used language for building web applications and managing databases. Node.js, an open-source runtime environment, allows execution of JavaScript outside the browser, making it ideal for developing back-end services such as APIs. Other general-purpose programming languages like Python, Ruby, Java, Golang, and C# are also employed in various applications, each offering unique advantages depending on project requirements.

In addition to these languages, database management systems (DBMS) play a critical role by managing data storage and retrieval for web applications. Together, these components form the backbone of modern web technology, enabling the creation of dynamic, interactive, and efficient online experiences.

section_summaries.text: Web Technology involves tools and techniques for internet communication, including web browsers, web pages, web servers, and web development. Web browsers display content from web pages, while web servers manage requests and serve pages via HTTP. Web development splits into frontend (user-interactable elements) and backend (server-side data handling). Frontend development uses languages like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for interactive user interfaces.

HTML is used for designing web pages' front-end. CSS simplifies styling web pages independently of HTML content. JavaScript enhances website interactivity and functionality. AJAX improves user experience by communicating with servers without page refreshes.

For backend development, PHP is a server-side scripting language. Node.js is an open-source runtime environment for executing JavaScript outside the browser, used for building back-end services like APIs. Python and Ruby are general-purpose programming languages, while Java is popular and scalable. Golang and C# are also used in various applications. DBMS manages databases.
